quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to park a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon a street other than upon the roadway against the curb or upon the sidewalk in a rack to support the bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter or against a building or at the curb, in such a manner as to afford the least obstruction to pedestrian traffic.

activation.condition: A person parks a covered bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon a City street.

obligation.description: Use one of the listed roadway/sidewalk placement alternatives with least obstruction to pedestrian traffic, subject to unresolved modifier attachment.

timing.description: Original parking act and stationary placement with contemporaneous pedestrian passage.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Qualitative placement and feasible pedestrian-passage alternatives remain legally unresolved; distance is descriptive, not a cutoff.
